<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FII Outflows:</strong> Foreign institutional investors have aggressively exited Indian equities, withdrawing over ₹44,000 crore in October alone, contributing to a significant market correction.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Drivers:</strong> Investors are closely monitoring crude oil price volatility, upcoming Q2 corporate earnings from major firms like HDFC Bank and Wipro, and inflation data as key determinants for near-term market direction.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
